{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(sales.head())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_filtered = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output
print(f"\nMean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Return the result
mean_revenue"}
